slots.palette: warm pastel palette with deep blue night accents
slots.setting: a lively night market ramen stall for cute hungry animals
slots.decorations: Light wooden stall fronts, cloth awnings and a few tiled rooftops around the edges of the screen.
slots.background_tones: warm (cream, light wood, soft lantern glow)
slots.kitchen: a steaming ramen stall with a cloth awning
slots.loop_interior: a plain light wooden counter surface
slots.foods: a mini ramen bowl, a gyoza, a takoyaki ball, a small skewer or a soft-boiled egg half
slots.board_surface: a pale wooden counter top framed with a thin darker wood border, lit by warm lantern light
slots.obstacles: a soy sauce bottle, a chopstick holder and a small paper lantern
slots.mood: lively, warm and cozy, with everyone happily slurping and eating
slots.night_sky: a dark blue night sky above the rooftops, only along the top and outer edges
slots.light_sources: strings of red paper lanterns along the edges, a glowing stall sign with a simple bowl icon and no text, and small table lanterns on the counter
slots.effects: soft curls of steam rising from the stall, lantern strings framing the screen edges, and a few warm windows glowing on the rooftops
slots.extra_avoid: readable signs or shop text, steam covering the plates or tickets, red light on the board
